name: Vedas
overview: 4 Vedas containing hymns, rituals, cosmology, and spiritual knowledge. They form the foundational layer of Hindu thought and practice and are the source of later philosophical traditions.

name: Upanishads
overview: 108 traditionally recognized philosophical texts exploring Brahman, Atman, consciousness, self-realization, and liberation. They represent the culmination of Vedic wisdom.

name: Mahabharata
overview: The world's longest epic with approximately 100,000 verses. It explores dharma, ethics, politics, kingship, warfare, and contains the Bhagavad Gita.

name: Bhagavad Gita
overview: 700 verses across 18 chapters. A dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna covering karma yoga, bhakti yoga, jnana yoga, duty, and liberation.

name: Brahma Sutras
overview: 555 aphorisms that systematize and interpret the teachings of the Upanishads, forming a core text of Vedanta.
